Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly swapped the release years in its "Updated Understanding" section. While the WebSurfer correctly identified "Repeated Absences" as 1972 and "She Wore A Yellow Ribbon" as 1949, the Planner erroneously recorded them as "Repeated Absences = 1949" and "She Wore a Yellow Ribbon = 1972". This data inversion led to the logically flawed conclusion that "Repeated Absences" came out first, contradicting the actual chronological order of the retrieved data.
